events.summary: Li Wei, 2026-09-22: NOTICE OF FORCE MAJEURE - Shenzhen Yunzhan Precision Motor Co., Ltd. (force majeure, auto)

Li Wei of Shenzhen Yunzhan Precision Motor Co., Ltd. (SUP-0001, on file, sender matches the contact on file) gave formal force majeure notice dated 22 Sep 2026 under clause 14 of the 2023 Supply Agreement: a fire on 18 Sep at Bao'an Plant 2 stopped deliveries from that plant. Ten open lines across HPO-26-00450, -00532, -00614 and -00670 cannot ship, covering HR-40110, HR-40120, HR-40130, HR-40210 and HR-40230 (Dana Reyes's motor parts). The four lines with confirmed dates of 25 Aug, 26 Aug, 28 Aug and 23 Sep are already past due against the data date of 25 Sep 2026; the 25 Sep line is due today, not yet past due; the other five are dated 26 Oct to 26 Nov. Their new dates are unknown until the supplier delivers revised dates by 10 Oct 2026 (15 days after the data date); its recovery estimate is 6 to 8 weeks, to about 17 Nov 2026, and it is moving some BLDC work to Plant 1 and prioritising long-term customers.
Still waiting for Buyer's clerk to finish
Step 1 is done, so the next step is the reply draft.

args.subject: Your force majeure notice of 22 September: revised promise dates and allocation
args.body:
Dear Li Wei,

Thank you for your notice of 22 September about the fire at Bao'an Plant 2. We have received it and are reviewing it against the Supply Agreement. This reply does not accept the claim or waive any of Halden's rights under the agreement.

Please send us, in writing and as soon as you can, a revised promise date for each of these open lines:

HPO-26-00450 line 20, HR-40120, 445 pcs, previously 25 August
HPO-26-00450 line 10, HR-40110, 355 pcs, previously 26 August
HPO-26-00532 line 10, HR-40130, 1320 pcs, previously 28 August
HPO-26-00614 line 10, HR-40110, 435 pcs, previously 23 September
HPO-26-00614 line 30, HR-40230, 250 pcs, previously 25 September
HPO-26-00532 line 20, HR-40210, 163 pcs, previously 30 September
HPO-26-00614 line 20, HR-40110, 350 pcs, previously 26 October
HPO-26-00670 line 10, HR-40120, 400 pcs, previously 30 October
HPO-26-00670 line 20, HR-40130, 1030 pcs, previously 24 November
HPO-26-00532 line 30, HR-40210, 144 pcs, previously 26 November

You said revised dates would follow by 10 October. Please confirm that date, or send them sooner if you have them.

Please also tell us what quantity you can allocate to Halden from Plant 1 (Longgang) for these parts, line by line, and from which dates. Please say which lines, if any, you expect to ship from stock that was not damaged.

Regards,
Halden Robotics Purchasing

recommendation.finding: Li Wei at Shenzhen Yunzhan Precision Motor, who is on file and matches the contact, gave formal force majeure notice for a 18 September fire at Bao'an Plant 2. Ten open lines on four POs (motor parts for Dana Reyes) cannot ship. Four of them are past due and one is due today. The supplier says recovery takes 6 to 8 weeks and that it will send revised dates by 10 October. A reply is drafted for approval. It asks for written revised dates and Plant 1 allocation per line, accepts nothing and waives no rights. Separately, a "Yunzhan Accounts" message with new bank details is blocked: do not act on it, and confirm any bank change by phone with the contact on file. Dana should also open a second-source question for the motors.
